def priority(f):
    progress = f["progress"]
    cluster_density = f["cluster_density"]
    spread = f["spread"]
    
    # Return ramp (commit phase)
    rw = 0.2 + 0.45 * progress
    
    # Regret decaying (early uniqueness)
    rgw = 0.35 - 0.25 * progress
    
    # Cluster bias: penalize high spread, reward cluster_density
    # spread is std normalized; penalize when spread > 1
    spread_penalty = -0.15 * max(0.0, spread - 0.8) * (1.0 - 0.5 * progress)
    
    # Density-modulated nearest boost
    cl = 0.15 * cluster_density * (1.0 - 0.3 * progress)
    
    return -f["distance"] + rw * f["return_distance"] + rgw * f["regret"] + cl * f["nearest_remaining"] + spread_penalty
```

def priority(f):
    progress = f["progress"]
    cluster_density = f["cluster_density"]
    
    # In dense clusters, rely on regret less (clear ranking)
    # In sparse regions, regret matters more (uncertain ranking)
    rgw = 0.35 - 0.25 * progress - 0.15 * cluster_density
    
    rw = 0.2 + 0.45 * progress
    
    # Density-modulated nearest boost

    return -f["distance"] + rw * f["return_distance"] + rgw * f["regret"] + cl * f["nearest_remaining"]
```
